messages:
Micah: heads-up: ACME (enterprise) just bumped priority. They need Dedicated to hit ~2.5k sustained TPS on embeddings with 95p < 80ms. Sales wants commitment for Q3 deliverable. Can we scope tradeoffs?
Anya: can we get current baseline for their model (redwood/roberta-13B-quant)?
Kenji: baseline numbers: ~720 TPS on 8xA10G pool, 95p ~140ms. KV cache currently disabled for embeddings route.
Sarah: that's a big gap. Trade options: kernel perf wins, lower-bit quant, KV prefix caching, or add more nodes.
Lina: customer is cost-sensitive; they asked that infra cost not exceed ~1.5x current spend. Prefer SW fixes.
Micah: ok prioritize approaches that deliver >=2x throughput at <=1.5x cost. Which combos look realistic?
Kenji: rough quick math: fused-attn kernel opt ~1.25x, int4 quant ~1.8x (quality risk), KV prefix cache benefits depend on reuse - could be >2x if hot prefixes >40%, model routing to smaller variant ~1.5x average. KC + quant seems promising.
Anya: propose launch criteria for a canary: functional: KV cache enabled on embeddings + safe fallback; perf: replayed-customer workload shows 2.5k sustained TPS; quality: embedding similarity drift <=1.5% on eval; cost: infra <=1.5x; telemetry: cache-hit + per-request metrics available.
Micah: add requirement: auto-fallback/rollback if drift exceeds threshold in prod during canary.
Sarah: implementation sketch and rough timeline (parallel streams):
- KV cache POC (GPU memory-mapped LRU) - 2w
- integrate cache into runtime, add metrics - 1w
- quant calibration + kernel path changes + test runs - 2w
- run replay with customer dataset + perf runs - 1w
- 10% canary in single region, monitor for 1w
~6 weeks dev + 1 week buffer = ~7-8 weeks.
Kenji: note: quant path hit a flaky unit test (ci-bot flagged). Need +2w contingency for kernel fixes. Also need a spot-farm for large replay runs.
Micah: sales asked for 8-week firm target. Can we commit with caveats?
Anya: yes if we limit canary to one region, one model variant, and run parallel teams on cache+quant. Must list risks to sales.
Lina: I'll tell ACME the 8-week goal and propose a canary-only SLA for first 30 days.
Kenji: action: bench infra request for replay capacity + cost estimate (Kenji) - due EOD Tue.
Anya: action: write launch criteria doc + rollback thresholds - due Wed.
Micah: action: ask ACME for replay dataset + align on canary traffic window - due Thu.
Lina: action: negotiate contract timeline to allow canary SLA - due Fri.
Kenji: perf-bot: queued replay job id=8911 against canary (config: --model redwood/roberta-13B-int4 --threads 64).
perf-bot: replay job 8911 started on spot-farm-4, ETA 2.5h.
ci-bot: FYI flaky test on int4 kernel surfaced in CI. Tracing stack now.
Sarah: schedule OKR checkpoint in 3w to reassess if quant stalls.
Micah: propose KR: "Reduce 95p latency for embeddings on Dedicated by 40% for top enterprise customers". We'll attach ACME as exemplar.
Anya: fine, but attach baseline cluster numbers.
Kenji: will post initial bench and replay results in this thread when available.
Lina: devops access needed for replay S3. @devops please grant read-only to participants.
devops-bot: access request ticket #INC-2134 created, ETA 48h.
Micah: risks to call out to legal/sales: possible quality regressions from int4, perf variability across AZs, capacity during on-peak bursts. Make sure contract accounts for canary fallback.
Anya: agreed. Ping me immediately if replay shows drift >0.5%.
Micah: thanks all; we'll reconvene after Kenji's bench numbers. Keeping thread short here.
